mission: He Didn’t Jump is An Aziel Eliab Project: an independent historical newspaper and five-volume archive examining the death of U.S. Representative Marion Zioncheck in Seattle on 7 August 1936. The official report called it suicide from a fifth-floor Arctic Building office. This project challenges that 90-year official suicide narrative and publishes the record for re-reading. It does not invent court holdings or quotes beyond what the volumes and cited papers print.
